scenarios.name: first-entry-inquire
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the map initialised and sent (ERASE), then the same task's RECEIVE (the operator's input): option 1 inquires commercial policy 10 of customer 1 (LINK LGIPOL01 -> LGIPDB01); the policy shown, RETURN TRANSID('SSP{n}') with COMM-AREA

scenarios.name: inquire
scenarios.why: option 1 on a returning task (EIBCALEN > 0: GO TO A-GAIN): commercial policy 9 of customer 5

scenarios.name: inquire-not-found
scenarios.why: option 1 for a policy the customer does not hold: LGIPDB01 sets CA-RETURN-CODE '01' -> NO-DATA ('No data was returned.'), ERROR-OUT sends the map and initialises the areas

scenarios.name: delete
scenarios.why: option 3: LINK LGDPOL01 (01DCOM) deletes policy 10 of customer 1 (POLICY row, cascade, VSAM copy); the fields blanked, 'Commercial Policy Deleted', SEND MAP twice

scenarios.name: delete-fails
scenarios.why: option 3 with LGDPDB01's DELETE failing (SQLCODE -913): CA-RETURN-CODE '90' -> SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK, NO-DELETE; the back end LINKs LGSTSQ first, so the task is judged up to LGSTSQ's refused WRITEQ (X6) and the rest is not compared

scenarios.name: bad-option
scenarios.why: option '9': WHEN OTHER -- 'Please enter a valid option', the option field's length -1 (cursor), SEND MAP ... CURSOR

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR: HANDLE AID CLEAR(CLEARIT) -- the map sent MAPONLY, RETURN TRANSID

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: PF3: HANDLE AID PF3(ENDIT) -- SEND TEXT 'Transaction ended' ERASE FREEKB, RETURN

scenarios.name: mapfail
scenarios.why: ENTER with no input: the RECEIVE raises MAPFAIL, HANDLE CONDITION MAPFAIL(ENDIT)

scenarios.name: add
scenarios.why: option 2: LINK LGAPOL01 ('01ACOM') adds a commercial policy for customer 3 (POLICY + COMMERCIAL rows, VSAM copy); the new numbers shown, 'New Commercial Policy Inserted'. LGTESTP4 sets no CA-BROKERID / CA-PAYMENT: they hold the spaces INITIALIZE leaves in CA-REQUEST-SPECIFIC, and LGAPDB01 MOVEs them to S9(9) COMP host variables -- the oracle's digit arithmetic on non-digits (C11, #4652), which the det runtime models

scenarios.name: add-unknown-customer
scenarios.why: option 2 for customer 999, who does not exist: LGAPDB01's INSERT into POLICY breaks its foreign key (SQLCODE -530) -> CA-RETURN-CODE '70', SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK, NO-ADD 'Customer does not exist'; the back end LINKs LGSTSQ first, so the task is judged up to LGSTSQ's refused WRITEQ (X6) and the rest is not compared

scenarios.name: add-fails
scenarios.why: option 2 with LGAPDB01's INSERT into POLICY failing (SQLCODE -913): CA-RETURN-CODE '90', SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK, NO-ADD WHEN OTHER 'Error Adding ... Policy'; the back end LINKs LGSTSQ first, so the task is judged up to LGSTSQ's refused WRITEQ (X6) and the rest is not compared

scenarios.name: inquire-by-policy
scenarios.why: option 1 with only a policy number: '02ICOM' (the commercial policy by number)

scenarios.name: inquire-by-customer
scenarios.why: option 1 with only a customer number: '03ICOM' (the customer's commercial policies)

scenarios.name: inquire-by-postcode
scenarios.why: option 1 with neither number, a postcode: '05ICOM' (the policies at that postcode)

scenarios.name: inquire-nothing
scenarios.why: option 1 with no number and no postcode: no request id is set (COMM-AREA's own, spaces) and LGIPOL01 is LINKed with it

notes: GenApp's commercial policy test transaction (LGTESTP4, transid SSP4, BMS map SSMAPP4 of mapset SSMAP: the symbolic map is generated from base/src/ssmap.bms, @bms/SSMAP.cpy). A first task (EIBCALEN 0) sends the initialised map and RECEIVEs in the same task; a returning one (EIBCALEN > 0; the program has no DFHCOMMAREA, its own COMM-AREA goes back through RETURN TRANSID) goes straight to the RECEIVE. HANDLE AID CLEAR / PF3 and HANDLE CONDITION MAPFAIL are exercised; the option field picks inquire (1: LGIPOL01), add (2: LGAPOL01, a failure is SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK), delete (3: LGDPOL01); option 1 builds the request from what is typed: both numbers (01ICOM), the policy (02ICOM), the customer (03ICOM), a postcode (05ICOM), or nothing. The case runs the whole chain in the task: the four front ends, their Db2 back ends, the VSAM services and LGSTSQ (twelve programs). The VSAM file is genapp-lgupdb01's; Db2 is db2cre.jcl's tables and rows. POLICY.LASTCHANGED, COMMERCIAL.REQUESTDATE and the COMMAREA's CA-LASTCHANGED are clock fields. Error paths in the back ends LINK LGSTSQ and are judged up to its refused WRITEQ (X6). LGTESTP4's option 2 sets no CA-BROKERID / CA-PAYMENT (LGTESTP1-3 MOVE 0 to them): they hold the spaces INITIALIZE leaves in CA-REQUEST-SPECIFIC, and LGAPDB01 MOVEs them to S9(9) COMP host variables -- non-digits in a numeric DISPLAY item (C11): the oracle INSERTs BROKERID 931773840 and PAYMENT 707773840 (each space counts -16, TRUNC(STD) keeps nine digits), which the det runtime models (#4652); IBM documents no result, so the successful add is proven against the oracle's arithmetic, not z/OS's. An add whose SELECT LASTCHANGED is faulted would INSERT a blank CA-LASTCHANGED as COMMERCIAL.REQUESTDATE, which the Db2 client rejects with no Db2 SQLCODE (Q10). Uncovered: IF CA-RETURN-CODE > 0 true after the add / delete / update LINKs, and NO-ADD / NO-DELETE / NO-UPD: every back-end failure LINKs LGSTSQ before it returns, and the task is judged up to LGSTSQ's refused WRITEQ (X6), so what follows is not compared or counted.
